The wet weight at birth, measured within hours of hatching, averages 4.5 grams [Wwb = 4.5 grams], reflecting the substantial yolk investment typical of semi-precocial nightjar chicks. This initial mass represents a modest fraction of the adult body mass that the growing nestling will eventually attain. The ultimate wet weight of adults, measured from a large series of museum specimens and supplemented by data from mist-netted individuals in the field, reaches approximately 46 grams [Wwi = approximately 46 grams], placing Systellura longirostris among the medium-sized members of its genus.
